labels.name: Urgent
labels.description: Active or imminent harm: fraud or identity theft in progress, money being lost or withheld right now, imminent foreclosure, repossession or eviction, legal threats or deadlines within days, harassment.

labels.name: Standard
labels.description: A concrete problem that needs action but no imminent harm: wrong fees or charges, account or payment errors, incorrect information, delayed processing, disputes already in progress.

labels.name: Low
labels.description: Questions, requests for information or documents, general dissatisfaction, feedback, or issues already resolved.
